record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four units in appliesTo declare SLUDGE in this production reference (all with passive NONE in the catalog, maxPP 100, range 1). The strategy is shared; differences are star count (1 or 2) and stats.
record.summary: Applies poison to every enemy standing in the three cells directly in front of the caster (towards its target). For each such enemy the strategy makes nbStacks successive triggerPoison calls (2/3/4/8 by stars: 1 star = 2, 2 stars = 3) with a duration of 3000/3000/3000/10000 ms scaled by AP (and critPower only if the cast crit). Each call adds one stack up to a cap of 3 (4 if the caster has VENOMOUS, 5 with TOXIC). So from zero stacks and without reactions a 1-star cast requests and applies 2 stacks and a 2-star cast requests and applies 3; only a 3-star cast (4 requested) exceeds the base cap of 3 (it applies 3, or 4 with VENOMOUS). The calls are not one atomic addition: immunity, Rune Protect and berry reactions are evaluated in each call (a Pecha Berry holder eats the berry during the first call, which clears the stacks and grants poison immunity, so the later calls do nothing). No direct damage. The poison then ticks about every 1000 ms: a negative computed amount requests a heal on the poisoned unit itself (reachable through the Gliscor formula), zero makes no call, a positive amount requests TRUE damage attributed to the poison origin; these are handler requests, not guaranteed HP changes.

targeting.who: enemy units in the cells returned by board.getCellsInFront(caster, target): up to three adjacent cells (the cast target's direction and its two neighbouring orientations, range 1). The target itself need not be hit unless it stands in one of those cells.
targeting.note: getCellsInFront also sets the caster's orientation towards the target as a side effect. The orientation function itself was not read; cells outside the board are dropped.

geometry.shape: the three cells adjacent to the caster in the cast direction (front and the two neighbouring orientations, range 1); only occupied cells holding an enemy (different team) are affected

effects.scaling: the strategy deals no damage itself; see statusEffects.0 for the requested vs applied stacks and duration, and for the per-second tick
effects.resolution: applied stacks come from the successive triggerPoison calls, capped at 3 (4 VENOMOUS, 5 TOXIC); each tick then computes round(5 % maxHP x stacks) (GLISCOR: stacks - 2) with the listed reductions and makes a heal request (negative), no call (zero) or a TRUE damage request of at least 1 (positive) on the poisoned unit; the final HP change is decided by handleHeal / handleDamage.

statusEffects.target: each enemy in the front cells
statusEffects.scaling: requested duration = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit)); the crit flag is rolled only if the caster has the ABILITY_CRIT effect (SLUDGE is not canCritByDefault). The stack count is not scaled by AP or crit.
statusEffects.applicationOrder: after super.process, per cell in the order returned (a Set of coordinates), per enemy: nbStacks successive triggerPoison calls
statusEffects.guards: each triggerPoison call is evaluated on its own. A call does nothing (no stack, no origin update, no passive or berry reaction) if the target has EffectEnum.IMMUNITY_POISON or its status has runeProtect; that check is the same in every call, so the whole sequence then has no effect. When a call applies: poisonOrigin = the caster; stacks + 1 up to maxStacks 3 (4 with VENOMOUS, 5 with TOXIC on the origin); the duration passes through the TARGET's applyStatusDurationReductions (SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER x0.3, then -10 % per ODD_KEYSTONE in the target player's items, rounded) and the timer is replaced only if longer; a target with the GUTS passive gains +5 attack once and with TOXIC_BOOST +10 once; a PECHA_BERRY holder eats the berry in the same call (eatBerry: heal, poisonOrigin = null, poisonStacks = 0, poisonDamageCooldown = 0, IMMUNITY_POISON added, the berry removed), so the remaining calls of the loop find IMMUNITY_POISON and do nothing: the holder ends with 0 stacks although the timer set by the first call remains. Pinned-helper probe (AP 0, no crit, from zero stacks, no other reactions): 1 star 2 calls -> 2 stacks, 2 stars 3 calls -> 3 stacks, 3 stars 4 calls -> 3 stacks (4 with VENOMOUS on the caster); Rune Protect and IMMUNITY_POISON -> 0 stacks and no timer; Pecha Berry holder -> 0 stacks, IMMUNITY_POISON set, berry gone; target HYDRATION halves 3000 to 1500.
statusEffects.combatEffect: while poisonStacks > 0 the status ticks every 1000 ms (poisonDamageCooldown): poisonDamage = maxHP x 0.05 x stacks (GLISCOR: stacks - 2), x0.7 in RAIN, x0.5 with ASSAULT_VEST, x0.5 with the TOXIC_BOOST passive, then x0.7 SWIFT_SWIM, else x0.5 HYDRATION, else x0.3 WATER_VEIL / SURGE_SURFER, then Math.round. Negative: pkm.handleHeal(round(-x), pkm, 0, false), a heal REQUEST on the poisoned unit; zero: no call at all; positive: pkm.handleDamage with damage min(1)(round(x)), attackType TRUE, attacker = poisonOrigin or null, no mana gain. These are handler requests, not guaranteed HP changes (same reading as the repaired LEECH_SEED candidate). When poisonCooldown runs out the stacks and origin are cleared and the GUTS / TOXIC_BOOST attack bonuses are removed.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (4 stacks, 3000 ms) and 4-star (8 stacks, 10000 ms) entries are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts (1 and 2). With the default cap of 3 stacks the requested 2 or 3 stacks fit the cap on a fresh target; on a target already carrying stacks the cap limits the sum.

record.positionalConditions: The affected cells depend on the caster-to-target direction; only enemies standing in those three cells are poisoned. The unit must be in range of its target to cast (requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast adds more stacks (up to the cap) and refreshes the duration only if longer; poisonOrigin becomes the latest caster.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 2 (1 star) or 3 (2 stars) successive poison applications with 3000 ms raw duration. Applied from zero stacks without reactions: 2 and 3 stacks (inside the cap of 3); duration x (1 + AP/100) [x critPower on crit], rounded, then the target's reductions; nothing against poison immunity or Rune Protect; a Pecha Berry holder ends with no stacks. Each tick is a handler request (heal on the poisoned unit, nothing, or TRUE damage), not a guaranteed HP change.
